definitions.full: H342. ebah אֵיבָה noun feminine enmity — ׳י Gen 3:15 2 t.; construct אֵיבַת Ezek 25:15 ; 35:5 — enmity , personal hostility, between men Num 35:21-22 , (P), between serpent & woman Gen 3:15 (J), between peoples עוֺלָם אֵיבַת Ezek 25:15 ; 35:5 .
